mission: D9 F1 rule rollout (owner allowed the yuyutei redeploy, 2026-10-18 13:57Z): PR #171 was merged by hand under hold-for-owner, which skips the collector rollout. This delivery releases the already-merged resolver to the nine yuyutei collector shards one at a time and re-verifies staging. No code change; proposals only, nothing approved; snkrdunk untouched.

impacts.reason: Records why PR #171 needs this follow-up delivery. The delivery redeploys the nine yuyutei shards (collector_services) to the merged staging head, which already contains the PR #171 resolver; no application file changes.

resources.name: Staging Postgres (no migration; proposal rows written by ordinary discovery turns)

dependencies: PR #171 (merged 2026-10-18 14:36Z, rollout skipped by hand merge); resolver 1.3 receipt a504e476
impact.deployment_impact: Nine yuyutei collector shards redeployed sequentially to the merged head by deploy_staging_collectors (refuses to start 02:00-06:00 UTC, restores newest-first on failure). snkrdunk-collector not in collector_services. No raw_dependency_migration, no DDL, no variable, schedule, budget or pacing change.

recovery.procedure: Automatic during rollout: every touched shard restored newest-first to its recovery_deployment_id (the PR #103 a504e476 images; fleet-vs-receipt 10/10 at 2026-10-18 13:59Z). After delivery: native revert of PR #171 delivered the same way. Proposals written by the rule stay as pending history; nothing is approved by this change.
recovery.trigger: Any drop in approved exact or approved-with-proof counts versus pre-release staging-state; any stored proposal differs RuntimeError; any discovery failure; any 403/429/challenge; deployment failure; schedule or flag drift; more new proposal versions on the first full discovery cycle than about 1,000 (about 762 prints expected: 775 MEASURED in sizing run 39076525684, less 13 bare-P promo prints the rule now leaves to the special-rarity rule).
recovery.backup: No schema change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue; no row is rewritten, only new proposal versions appended.

verification.observation_window: Delivery artifact plus one completed natural discovery turn per Yuyu shard on the new code. Then: approved exact and approved-with-proof unchanged; new exact pending proposals about 762 with reason unique_listing_kind_resolves_one_release_sibling; 0 stored-proposal-differs errors; 0 discovery failures; lossless green; storage-rates 48 h after release.

operational_notes: Identity-capture batches were paused 2026-10-17 15:41Z to 2026-10-18 13:57Z (owner decisions). They are RESUMED as before: each enqueue-remaining-50 ops-write batch is still dispatched as a dry run first and approved by the owner in the staging-ops Environment. Capture-day storage cuts (options A to G) are not built: the remaining backlog is about 300 MB one-off against 2,825 MB room.
D9 F2 (about 220 prints waiting on capture intents or captures) is no longer stalled; it proceeds with the resumed batches.

F1 go-live: about 762 exact proposals from this rule go live only in owner-approved ops-write batches of about 500, with a 48 h storage check after each.
